name: PD 93 was established by Ordinance No. 15550, passed by the Dallas City Council on July 13, 1977. Ordinance No. 15550 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the 1960 Revised Code of Civil and Criminal Ordinances of the City of Dallas, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 15550; 25423)
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 93 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-93.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 93 was established by Ordinance No. 15550, passed by the Dallas City Council on July 13, 1977. Ordinance No. 15550 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the 1960 Revised Code of Civil and Criminal Ordinances of the City of Dallas, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 15550; 25423)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-93.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 93 is established on property generally located at the northeast corner of Turner Way and Preston Road. The size of PD 93 is approximately 19.2 acres. (Ord. Nos. 15550; 25423)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-93.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25423)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-93.104.DEVELOPMENT PLAN. All development must be in conformance with a site plan (Exhibit 93A) which has been approved by the city plan commission and city council. (Ord. Nos. 15550; 25423)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: SEC. 51P-93.105.USES. The PD may be used for single-family detached residential dwellings and private park, as indicated on the approved site plan. Within the area designated as private park, the following uses are permitted: swimming pool, tennis courts, and cabana with shelters. (Ord. Nos. 15550; 25423)

sections.title: Subdivisions
sections.text: SEC. 51P-93.106.SUBDIVISIONS. Prior to issuance of any building permits, a subdivision plat, as approved by the city plan commission, shall be filed for record with the county clerk, Dallas County, Texas. (Ord. Nos. 15550; 25423)

sections.title: Density
sections.text: SEC. 51P-93.107.DENSITY. A maximum of 83 dwelling units is permitted. (Ord. Nos. 15550; 25423)

sections.title: Building Setbacks
sections.text: SEC. 51P-93.108.BUILDING SETBACKS. All buildings must be set back as indicated on the approved site plan. No building may be located closer than 10 feet to any dedicated street. A zero side yard is permitted on one side of each individually platted lot as indicated on the approved site plan, with a minimum side yard of six feet for the remaining side yard. A minimum rear yard of 10 feet must be provided. (Ord. Nos. 15550; 25423)

sections.title: Landscaping And Screening
sections.text: SEC. 51P-93.109.LANDSCAPING AND SCREENING. A three-foot landscaping strip must be provided along the east and south property lines and a solid masonry screening wall not less than seven feet in height must be provided along the inside of said landscaping strip, and on Preston Road, as indicated on the approved site plan, and no openings or breaks are permitted in the wall. (Ord. Nos. 15550; 25423)

sections.title: Street Dedication
sections.text: SEC. 51P-93.110.STREET DEDICATION. All residential lots must be served by a dedicated street with a minimum right-of-way of 46 feet. (Ord. Nos. 15550; 25423)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text: SEC. 51P-93.111.PAVING. Paving for all public streets, auto courts, and parking areas must meet the specifications and requirements of the department of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 15550; 25423)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text: SEC. 51P-93.112.PARKING. Parking must be provided at a ratio of two spaces for each single-family detached dwelling unit. (Ord. Nos. 15550; 25423)

sections.title: Height
sections.text: SEC. 51P-93.113.HEIGHT. No structure within the PD may exceed a maximum height of 30 feet. (Ord. Nos. 15550; 25423)

sections.title: Coverage
sections.text: SEC. 51P-93.114.COVERAGE. Maximum lot coverage (ground floor) is 60 percent of the total lot area. (Ord. Nos. 15550; 25423)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text: SEC. 51P-93.115.SIGNS. All signs must comply with the non-business regulations as specified in Chapter 41, "Sign Standards," of the Dallas City Code. (Ord. Nos. 15550; 25423)

sections.title: Homeowners’ Association
sections.text: SEC. 51P-93.116.HOMEOWNERS’ ASSOCIATION. A homeowners’ association must be created by the developer for the proper care and maintenance of the common areas and facilities. The instrument creating the homeowners’ association must be approved by the city attorney, submitted to the city plan commission, and filed in the deed records of Dallas County, Texas, prior to the sale of any lot or tract. (Ord. Nos. 15550; 25423)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-93.117.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.
(a)All development within this PD must be in conformance with all other codes and regulations of the city.
(b)All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications adopted for such purpose to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.
(c)No certificate of occupancy shall be issued by the building official until there has been full compliance with this article in accordance with the requirements of the building for which the certificate is issued, and any applicable provisions of the zoning ordinance and the building codes. (Ord. Nos. 15550; 25423; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-93.118.ZONING MAP. PD 93 is located on Zoning Map No. D-7. (Ord. 25423)
